items: 【Ample Storage Space】The nightstand has an 11 inch deep rattan mesh drawer and open shelves that provide ample storage space. The surface of the side table is large enough to place a table lamp on it, as well as remote controls, cups, magazines, etc. ideal for your bedroom and living room, making the space more tidy and orderly.

【Elegant Design】This bedside table is a perfect combination of bohemian style and elegant aesthetics, the whole is made of light white oak frame, its elegant rattan net finish and golden pull ring form the drawer, forming a unique appearance of the nightstand,suitable for various styles of home decoration, deliver perfect visual effect, add charming to your home.

【Durable & Sturdy】The sturdy legs and high-quality density board of this accent table ensure years of use and long-term stability. Make nightstands look great, last a long time and be easy to clean.The large square tabletop, white oak color surface and natural rattan constituted this mid century nightstand.

【Multifunctional use】The white side table with bohemian style can be perfectly matched with any style at home, the simple design of the rattan nightstand meets various storage needs in the bedroom, and can be used as a reception in children's room, bedroom, living room, apartment or office decorative storage table.It is ready to hold everything you need with easy reach.Ideal as a sofa table, corner table, night stand, end table, bedside tables, laptop desk, lamp table for your living room, bedroom, hallway, or office.

【Easy to Assemble】Our living room table comes with clear instructions showing illustrations and labeling all spare parts. All kinds of screws are labeled and packaged individually, and all parts are also labeled, so as to provide customers with a better user experience.
